top_signals.title: Franklin Templeton CEO Hopes Indonesia Changes on MSCI Warning
top_signals.summary: Franklin Templeton’s Jenny Johnson said the warning from MSCI Inc. to Indonesia will be constructive, giving extra impetus for the country to improve governance and transparency in its equities market.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Google disrupts million-device XCPE Android malware botnet, bans TV box maker
top_signals.summary: Google and industry partners have dismantled the XCPE malware botnet consisting of more than 1.3 million Android TV streaming TV boxes that Google says its manufacturer intentionally infected with malware to generate revenue through cybercrime activities. [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Binance outflows hit $4.7 billion after record North Korea hack
top_signals.summary: Net withdrawals from the platform reached $4.7 billion by Monday morning in London, according to a Binance spokesperson.
